notes:
- Excel-like column filters in every list: values with counts, amount and date ranges, sorting from the column header
- Income / Expense: one list with New income / New expense (like Collection / Payment) for cash entries without an account (canteen, ticket desk, rent, bills, groceries…), with standard income and expense types built in; in the base currency they can be switched on in Settings > Company
- Payment types in two levels: Cash, Bank, Cheque, Promissory note, POS, Digital POS, Credit card and Gift voucher, with your own banks and POS devices under them
- Daily cash book: every money movement of a day and the end-of-day balance of each payment type and unit; carried-over cash is entered on the Opening balances screen
- Payment type ledger report: every movement of a payment type with a running balance that starts from the carried-over balance, for a day or a date range, with the end-of-day balances on the side
- Transfer now moves money between payment types (cheque cashed, POS to bank, cash deposited or withdrawn); it replaces the transfer between accounts (old records stay)
- Quick entry: every record type on one screen, one after another (Ctrl/Cmd+J, Alt+1…7)
- Record types have their own color and icon everywhere
- Setup starts with a Company step: name, country, province / state, city, base currency (a missing currency is added automatically), business sector and contact details; the same fields are in Settings > Company
- Business sectors add matching income and expense categories
- New home page cards: cash position, monthly in – out, income / expense split, cash over 30 days and the monthly collection rate
- Day closing shows income and expense separately and stores the end-of-day cash balances
- Error reports are sent by e-mail from your mail app (no GitHub account needed); the full report is also on the clipboard
- Fixed: the screen could go blank after two quick page changes
- Fixed disk: only the first setup is refused with a "run it from a USB disk" message; existing data on a fixed disk no longer opens read only
- A transfer package can be saved only on the USB disk the program runs from
